 minmax(520px, 1fr) 420px; }
.review-sidebar, .requirements-panel { position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(8, 18, 16, .98); }
.review-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-right: 1px solid var(--review-line); }
.project-head { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 22px 20px 16px; }
.project-logo { width: 42px; height: 42px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(182,255,57,.45); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--review-accent); background: #12241a; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 900; }
.project-head h1, .project-head p { margin: 0; }
.project-head h1 { font-size: 18px; }
.project-head p { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--review-muted); font-size: 11px; }
.mode-label { margin: 0 16px 14px; padding: 9px 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #263a31; border-radius: 9px; color: #cbd7d2; background: #102019; font-size: 12px; }
.mode-label span, .workspace-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--review-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(182,255,57,.5); }
.page-search { height: 38px; margin: 0 16px 10px; padding: 0 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--review-line); border-radius: 9px; background: #0d1a17; color: var(--review-muted); }
.page-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--review-text); background: transparent; }
.page-menu { flex: 1; overflow: auto; padding: 0 10px 18px; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: #30423e transparent; }
.menu-group { margin: 12px 0 5px; padding: 0 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; color: #72837e; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.menu-group b { border: 1px solid #263a31; border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 6px; color: #91a19c; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0; }
.page-menu button { width: 100%; min-height: 38px; margin: 2px 0; padding: 8px 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: #a8b7b2; background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.page-menu button:hover { color: #e9f4ef; background: #101f1b; }
.page-menu button.active { color: #0b170f; background: var(--review-accent); font-weight: 800; }
.page-menu button span { min-width: 22px; color: inherit; font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; opacity: .68; }
.sidebar-foot { padding: 14px 20px 18px; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--review-line); color: var(--review-muted); font-size: 11px; }
.sidebar-foot strong { color: var(--review-accent); font-size: 18px; }
.preview-workspace { min-width: 0; min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 32%, #172620 0, #0a1412 38%, #07100f 75%); }
.workspace-bar { width: 100%; height: 80px; padding: 17px 26px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(45,65,60,.55); }
.eyebrow { color: var(--review-accent); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .16em; }
.workspace-bar h2 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 16px; }
.workspace-status { padding: 7px 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #283a35; border-radius: 999px; color: #9baca7; background: #0a1512; font: 11px ui-monospace, monospace; }
.preview-stage { width: 100%; flex: 1; min-height: 720px; padding: 28px; display: grid; place-items: start center; overflow: auto; }
.prototype-canvas { width: 375px; height: 812px; display: block; border: 0; background: #071512; box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.38); }
.workspace-hint { margin: 0; padding: 12px 20px 18px; color: #667772; font-size: 11px; text-align: center; }
.requirements-panel { border-left: 1px solid var(--review-line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.requirements-head { padding: 24px 22px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--review-line); }
.requirements-head h2 { margin: 8px 0 7px; font-size: 22px; }
.requirements-head p { margin: 0; color: #91a19c; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; }
.review-summary { margin: 14px 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border: 1px solid var(--review-line); border-radius: 10px; background: #0d1916; }
.review-summary div { padding: 10px 8px; display: grid; gap: 3px; text-align: center; }
.review-summary div + div { border-left: 1px solid var(--review-line); }
.review-summary strong { font-size: 13px; }
.review-summary span { color: var(--review-muted); font-size: 9px; }
.requirements-list { flex: 1; overflow: auto; padding: 0 16px 24px; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
.requirement-card { width: 100%; margin: 9px 0; padding: 14px 14px 14px 48px; position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--review-line); border-radius: 11px; color: var(--review-text); background: #0d1916; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s, background .2s, transform .2s; }
.requirement-card:hover { border-color: #3b5149; transform: translateY(-1px); }
.requirement-card.active { border-color: var(--review-marker); background: #211617; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,77,79,.12); }
.requirement-number { position: absolute; left: 13px; top: 13px; width: 24px; height: 24px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; color: white; background: var(--review-marker); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; }
.requirement-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 13px; }
.requirement-card p { margin: 0; color: #a8b7b2; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.8; }
.requirement-card[data-requirement-id$="-rules"] { border-color: rgba(182,255,57,.32); background: linear-gradient(145deg, #102019, #0d1916); }
.requirement-card[data-requirement-id$="-rules"] h3 { color: var(--review-accent); }
.empty-search { padding: 28px 14px; color: var(--review-muted); font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }
@media (max-width: 1300px) { .review-shell { grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(470px,1fr) 380px; } }

html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-width: 1120px; overflow: hidden; background: #07100f; }
body { color: #eef7f2; }
.review-shell { width: 100%; height: 100vh; }
.preview-stage { min-height: 0; }
.prototype-canvas { position: relative; width: 375px; height: 812px; flex: 0 0 auto; overflow: hidden; background: #06110f; box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.38); }
.prototype-canvas > .status-bar { position: absolute; }
.prototype-canvas > #app { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.review-annotated-target { isolation: isolate; }
.review-marker { position:absolute!important; z-index:500!important; inset:auto -5px auto auto!important; top:-7px!important; width:23px!important; height:23px!important; min-width:23px!important; min-height:23px!important; padding:0!important; display:grid!important; place-items:center!important; border:2px solid #fff!important; border-radius:50%!important; color:#fff!important; background:#ff4d4f!important; box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.42)!important; font:900 10px/1 system-ui,sans-serif!important; cursor:pointer!important; transform:none!important; }
.review-marker[data-requirement-id$="-rules"] { inset:34px auto auto 3px!important; }
.review-marker.review-pulse { animation:reviewPulse 1.8s ease both!important; }
.review-focus-target { outline:2px solid #ff4d4f!important; outline-offset:4px!important; }
.review-scroll-top { position:absolute!important; z-index:600!important; right:14px!important; bottom:88px!important; width:38px!important; height:38px!important; display:none!important; place-items:center!important; border:1px solid rgba(182,255,57,.55)!important; border-radius:50%!important; color:#0b170f!important; background:#b6ff39!important; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35)!important; font:900 18px/1 system-ui!important; }
.review-scroll-top.visible { display:grid!important; }
@keyframes reviewPulse { 0%,100%{transform:scale(1)} 18%,60%{transform:scale(1.28);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(255,77,79,.18),0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.42)} }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .review-marker.review-pulse { animation:none!important; outline:4px solid rgba(255,77,79,.3)!important; } }
.record-detail-list { max-height: 205px; overflow: auto; display: grid; gap: 7px; padding: 8px 1px 2px; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: #3d4b61 transparent; }
.record-detail-item { border: 1px solid #2c394d; border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 10px; background: #121b28; }
.record-detail-item header, .record-detail-item > div { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.record-detail-item header strong { color: #f0f3f8; font-size: 11px; }

.record-detail-item > div { margin-top: 5px; }

.record-detail-item p { margin: 5px 0 1px; }

.search-screen { color:#f7f7f8; background:radial-gradient(circle at 85% 4%,#17254b 0,#080a11 28%,#07080d 58%); }
.search-scroll { padding-bottom:22px; background:transparent; }
.search-page-head { position:sticky; z-index:30; top:0; display:grid; grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr) 58px; gap:8px; align-items:center; min-height:66px; padding:9px 9px; border-bottom:1px solid #2b3850; background:linear-gradient(105deg,rgba(18,28,47,.98),rgba(25,39,68,.98)); box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.2); }
.search-back,.search-submit { min-width:44px; min-height:44px; border:0; font-weight:900; }

.search-page-field .icon { width:17px; height:17px; flex:0 0 auto; color:#9299a9; }
